news.headline: NeurAxis to Host Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Update Call on Tuesday, August 11, 2026
news.summary: NeurAxis confirmed it will release summarized Q2 2026 financial results (quarter ended June 30, 2026) before market open on Tuesday, August 11, 2026, followed by a conference call and webcast at 9:00am ET.

news.headline: NeurAxis Declares Q2 2026 Stock Dividend on Series B Preferred Stock
news.summary: NeurAxis's board declared its Q2 2026 dividend on Series B Preferred Stock payable entirely in new common shares (roughly 80,463 shares, based on accrued dividends divided by a $2.38 reference price) rather than cash, to holders of record as of July 21, 2026, with payment settling July 29, 2026.

news.headline: NeurAxis Stockholders Approve Director Elections and Equity Plan Expansion at 2026 Annual Meeting
news.summary: At its June 10, 2026 annual meeting, NeurAxis stockholders elected all six director nominees (including CEO Brian Carrico) and approved expanding the 2022 Omnibus Incentive Plan's authorized share pool from 1,482,152 to 3,400,000 shares plus a new 2025 Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings report and business update call
catalysts.detail: NeurAxis will report Q2 2026 financial results (quarter ended June 30, 2026) before market open with a 9:00am ET conference call; investors will watch whether the +80% YoY revenue growth and margin expansion seen in Q1 2026 continued, and whether VA-channel sales are becoming visible in the numbers.

catalysts.label: Further payer/insurer coverage expansion
catalysts.detail: Following the AMA Category I CPT code for PENFS (effective January 1, 2026) and insurer wins covering about 1.25 million lives announced in April 2026, NeurAxis has a recurring pattern of announcing new medical policy coverage decisions that could keep expanding its reimbursed addressable market.

catalysts.label: Adult IBS / expanded pediatric label FDA submissions
catalysts.detail: Management has publicly flagged plans to pursue expanded FDA indications for PENFS beyond the current pediatric/adolescent functional abdominal pain and dyspepsia clearances, including an adult IBS indication; no confirmed submission or clearance date has been disclosed.

catalysts.label: VA hospital system commercial rollout
catalysts.detail: NeurAxis holds a Federal Supply Schedule contract with the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (effective December 2025) and management said on the Q1 2026 call that early VA adoption was running ahead of internal expectations, though no analyst model yet includes VA revenue.

pulse: NeurAxis remains in a quiet news stretch heading into its next earnings print: June and July 2026 brought routine corporate actions rather than fresh commercial catalysts, with stockholders re-electing the board and expanding the equity incentive plan at the June 10 annual meeting, a Q2 stock dividend on Series B Preferred shares declared July 9 and settled July 29, and on July 28 the company locking in August 11 as its Q2 2026 earnings date. The stock has traded well above pre-CPT-code levels, reflecting the market's reaction to Q1's 80% YoY revenue growth, expanding gross margins, and narrowing cash burn. The August 11 report is the key near-term event to confirm the reimbursement-driven growth trajectory held up in Q2, with the still-unmodeled VA rollout, ongoing payer coverage wins, and potential adult-indication FDA submissions as medium-term catalysts to watch.
